content.title: Consolidate claude-code-shared/agents into pipeline-grouped layout
content.summary: claude-code-shared/agents/ is half-grouped: 15 agents sit loose at the top level beside 4 subfolders on mixed axes (personas, investigators, task-exporters, egress). Orchestrators are split from their leaves (investigator.md at top level, its 5 leaves in investigators/; export-tasks.md alone in task-exporters/ while its adapters live in egress/<channel>/). Three .sh scripts live under agents/ despite the CLAUDE.md rule that scripts belong in scripts/. registry.json covers only 20 of 33 agents, validate-registry.py fails today (5 orphans) and only globs top-level files so 8 nested unregistered agents go unseen, and architecture-auditor says A1-A7 in the registry but A1-A8 in its frontmatter. After weighing three layouts (by pipeline, by role, flat with family prefixes), the user accepted Option A: group agents by pipeline into build/, investigate/, egress/, seed-review/, learning/, shared/, skill-agents/. Scripts move to scripts/egress/, the gh naming is consolidated to github for export-tasks-gh and gh-issue.sh, ADR-0002 is superseded by a new ADR-0006, the registry and validator are fixed, and a generated agents/README.md index is added. Nothing is deleted: every file is moved or renamed via git mv.
content.problem_statement: The agents directory is hard to navigate and not self-documenting. Grouping is inconsistent, orchestrators are separated from the agents they call, scripts sit in the wrong bucket, and the registry that is meant to be the source of truth for agents is incomplete and its validator cannot see nested files.
content.solution: Reorganize agents/ by pipeline lane with git mv only, move companion scripts into scripts/egress/, rename the gh-named GitHub adapter pieces to github, register every agent, make the validator recurse, record the scripts-placement decision in ADR-0006, and generate an agents/README.md index from the registry.
content.evidence: find agents: 33 agent .md files, 3 .sh scripts, registry.json. validate-registry.py output: 'ERROR: orphaned agent file with no registry entry' for pr-code-review.md, artifact-grounding-judge.md, build-code.md, to-tasks.md, attribution-tracer.md (exit 1). validate-registry.py line 55 uses glob(os.path.join(agents_dir, "*.md")), top-level only. registry lists 20 names. install.sh:103 symlinks the whole agents dir into ~/$account/agents. zsh 'type gh' resolves to /opt/homebrew/bin/gh; gh-issue.sh runs 'gh issue create' and post-github.md uses 'gh api'. task-routing adapter key is already 'github-issues'.
decisions: Adopt Option A (group by pipeline) for claude-code-shared/agents/. Final folders: build/, investigate/, egress/, seed-review/, learning/, shared/, skill-agents/, plus registry.json and a generated README.md at the agents/ root.
build/ holds build-runner, lint-runner, test-runner, e2e-runner, browser-checker, visual-judge.
investigate/ holds investigator.md (moved from agents/) and investigator-{code,web,github,linear,notion}.md (moved from investigators/).

egress/ keeps answer-composer.md at its root, gains export-tasks.md (moved from task-exporters/), and keeps channel subfolders github/ (post-github, export-tasks-github), linear/ (post-linear, export-tasks-linear), notion/ (export-tasks-notion), slack/ (post-slack).
seed-review/ holds persona-accuracy, persona-coherence, persona-completeness, persona-grounding, persona-judge (moved from personas/).

The three shim agents (to-tasks, build-code, pr-code-review) are a deliberate pattern for running a skill in an isolated context window, not clutter. Keep them, place them in skill-agents/ (not skill-shims/), and keep their names identical to the matching skills.
Nothing is deleted. Every file is moved or renamed with git mv so history survives. Only directories left empty (investigators/, personas/, task-exporters/) disappear. Agent count stays 33.

Consolidate gh naming to github: rename agent export-tasks-gh to export-tasks-github (file and frontmatter name), gh-issue.sh to github-issue.sh, and tests/characterization/test-gh-adapter.sh to test-github-adapter.sh.
Move companion scripts out of agents/ into scripts/egress/: gh-issue.sh becomes github-issue.sh, check-token.sh becomes notion-check-token.sh, notion-page-api.sh keeps its name.
CLAUDE.md scripts rule wins over ADR-0002. Add ADR-0006 recording that scripts live in scripts/, and mark ADR-0002 status superseded. ADR-0002's file stays in place.
ADR-0001 (flat shared pool) explicitly permits grouping subfolders inside agents/, so Option A complies with it. Update its example folder paths.
Register all 13 agents missing from registry.json, update every moved file path, apply the export-tasks-github rename, and fix the architecture-auditor A1-A7 drift to A1-A8.
Make validate-registry.py recurse into subfolders (**/*.md) so nested agents are validated.
Fix the export-tasks-linear description, which names tasks-to-linear as its caller.

Add scripts/registration/gen-agents-readme.py that writes agents/README.md from the registry (name, lane, model, consumers), with a line noting skill-agents run the same-named skill in an isolated context window.

Leave untouched: gh CLI invocations (gh issue create, gh api), the CircleCI slug gh/Quaestor-Technologies/Quaestor-Web in repo-policy.json, the github-issues adapter key in task-routing.json, and history under .claude/hillclimb/, .claude/agent-bench/, docs/archive/, and .claude/worktrees/.
Work happens on a branch (not main). No commit until the user approves the diff.
implementation_decisions: Reference updates: registry.json file paths; export-tasks.md lines 19, 69, 152 (adapter name, notion check-token path, subagent_type); export-tasks-github.md name, heading, and script path (lines 2, 8, 46, 59); export-tasks-notion.md script paths (lines 47, 61, 69); notion-page-api.sh error text mentioning check-token.sh; answer-composer.md lines 21-22 (agents/investigators/ becomes agents/investigate/).

Skill reference updates: skills/debug/SKILL.md:97 (agents/browser-checker.md to agents/build/browser-checker.md); skills/pr-revise/SKILL.md:332 and skills/pr-code-review/SKILL.md:325 (agents/investigator.md to agents/investigate/investigator.md); skills/improve-skill-learnings/SKILL.md:207 example path (agents/personas/ to agents/seed-review/). skills/relay/SKILL.md needs no change because post-github and post-linear do not move.

Script and test updates: scripts/tests/test_answer_composer_agent.py path strings; tests/characterization/test-github-adapter.sh GH_SCRIPT path; scripts/tests/test_consistency_findings.py fixture names; scripts/registration/gen-architecture.py agent names, then regenerate architecture.html; comment references in scripts/dependency-graph/claude_tooling_extractor.py.
Doc updates: ADR-0001 example paths, CONTEXT.md line 15 agent path form (agents/<name>.md to agents/<group>/<name>.md), new ADR-0006, ADR-0002 status set to superseded.

Claude Code discovers agents recursively and spawns by frontmatter name, so moves do not break spawning. Only the export-tasks-github rename changes a spawn name; running sessions need a restart to see it. ~/.cch/agents and ~/.cco/agents symlink the whole directory and pick changes up automatically.
testing_decisions: Verify with validate-registry.py (must pass after recursion fix and new entries), the existing tests touching agent paths, and a repo grep for old paths outside history directories.
Count check: 33 agent files and 3 scripts present after the move, matching the original inventory.
risks_and_tradeoffs: The export-tasks-gh to export-tasks-github rename changes a spawnable name. Any caller not found by grep would fail to spawn the adapter.
shared/ is a catch-all for multi-consumer agents; it can grow vague if not policed.

out_of_scope.rationale: Splits families apart, e.g. investigator into orchestrators/ and its leaves into workers/.

out_of_scope.text: Option C (flat directory with family-prefixed renames of every agent).
out_of_scope.rationale: Highest churn: every subagent_type call, model-tiers.json, name-keyed learnings, and agent-bench history would change. A shim- prefix would also break the intentional skill-agent name match.

out_of_scope.text: Deleting the to-tasks, build-code, pr-code-review shim agents.
out_of_scope.rationale: They are a deliberate pattern for running skills in isolated context windows.

out_of_scope.text: Renaming gh CLI calls, the CircleCI gh/ slug, or the github-issues routing key.
out_of_scope.rationale: gh is the GitHub CLI binary name, CircleCI requires the gh/ slug format, and github-issues is already consistent.
They are history and must keep the paths they recorded.

further_notes: The user's stated reason for gh vs github (gh meaning a zsh script alias) did not match the code: no gh alias exists in dotfiles, gh resolves to the GitHub CLI, and the user's git scripts use the gx prefix. The user then chose to consolidate to github anyway.
A reusable inline audit prompt for applying the same process to other directories was produced in this conversation and printed for the user to copy.

Scripts were regrouped into lane folders on 2026-10-06 (PR #62, commit 0ee94ac). Script paths in this seed were updated to match, for example scripts/shared/validate-schema.py, scripts/learning/log-learning.py, scripts/registration/validate-registry.py (renamed from validate_registry.py), and scripts/dependency-graph/claude_tooling_extractor.py. New generator scripts go in scripts/registration/. All cited line numbers were re-checked and still point at the same code.
content.next_action: Run /to-tasks on this seed to break the agents/ consolidation into tasks, starting with a branch, then git mv moves and renames, then reference updates, registry/validator fixes, ADR-0006, and the README generator.
